items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: My first record date was... Kay [sic] Winding, or Kai as he was known later... And what happened was the gig became a fiasco... because of Allen Eager. Because Kai would say “hey what are we going to play?”

ctx.x: Yeah, a big producer. © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-

Savoy Records, Guild Records, whatever. And he called me and my first record date was, are you ready for this? My first record date, Kay [sic] Winding, or Kai as he was known later, Shelly Manne, Ed Safranski, and Allen, boy, I just drew a blank.
